name: Vampire - Move - Failures
description: Flavor text for failures a legendary

results.text: The vampire lurches forward but stumbles, its legendary grace faltering for a breath.
A sudden gust throws dust into its path, disrupting its unnatural movement.
An unseen force snags its cloak, leaving it exposed to the glaring torchlight.
Its fangs clench in frustration as roots erupt from the earth, halting its stride.
For a fleeting moment, its legendary speed falters—a flicker of mortality in its eyes.
